Additionally, if specific molecular studies show no overlap in the downstream cellular pathways affected by mutations in CWC27 and HNRNPA1, beyond general cellular stress. _(variant: If a common variant (AF > 1%) in CWC27 or HNRNPA1, predicted to cause loss-of-function or gain-of-function respectively, is found at a high frequency in gnomAD, it would challenge the rarity and specific pathogenicity of the proposed causal variants.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared downstream consequences of aberrant RNA splicing and protein aggregation in these distinct diseases could reveal common therapeutic targets. Modulating pathways involved in protein clearance, chaperone activity, or RNA quality control might offer benefit for both metaphyseal chondrodysplasia-retinitis pigmentosa syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 20.
